Parish Envelopes: Following previous discussion with the Parish Finance Committee we encourage consideration for those who use envelopes infrequently to consider the use of a standing order, (through this medium you have full control), of the donation at your disposal.
Further information is available from the parish website.
If you advance the standing order, (it can be processed on-line with your bank), or alternatively bring the completed mandate to your bank.
We request that when you are issuing your instruction to the bank, that you do so with your personal name, in doing so we can therefore identify from whom the standing order has been authorised.
It is with your authorisation that the standing order is either processed weekly or monthly.
Also, you can withdraw the mandate at your own discretion.
We would appreciate an acknowledgement of this transaction (via the parish email) when it is activated, so that we can have a copy for the parish records.
In the information forwarded we will require your address and telephone number.
Several parishioners recently have set up a standing order, however we do not know who these parishioners are because they have not provided an address.
We ask please that you follow the instructions above and email the parish to inform us who has authorised the standing order.

We request now that the boxes are delivered, if you have not previously returned or updated a parish Census card, please complete the card in the back of the box and return in the collection envelope.
Also, the Gift Aid card needs to be signed and returned if you are a taxpayer.
Those who avail of Standing Orders are also asked to complete a Census card and Gift Aid card.
These can be collected in each sacristy and returned at your convenience.
